1.description: Moved threat mods and flat threat effects of abilities like Shield Slam, Riposte, Ghostly Strike, Devastate, Crimson Champion, etc into the threat bonus of stances (Righteous-Fury, Defensive Stance, Mana-Forged Barrier and Bear form). In addition, the stances' threat bonus has been significantly increased. This change results in a positive buff of threat for all tank builds and opens up opportunities for new and creative cross-class tank builds.

6.description: Monster's Fierce Blows can now be Blocked. Just as with Stagger and Absorb effects, it pierces through 50% of the Block amount. This means that if you block 500 damage from a normal hit, you will be able to block 250 damage from a Fierce Blow.
Monster's Fierce Blow ability can no longer miss.

3.description: [Website] (Developer note): Some of the aforementioned web-changes required significant rewrites of existing systems, we will be proactive in checking the suggestions channel and our Bugtracker to catch any issues that may have slipped through!

0.description: Increased the chance to get the Big Love Rocket from the event box to 1% per opened box.

[Naxxramas Itemization Changes]

Attack Power on Dreadborne has been converted to Strength at a 45% rate an item with 88 attack power now has 40 Strength.

Dreadborne items that have Agility has had the Agility converted to 50% Strength, an item with 30 Agility and 30 Strength now has 45 Strength.

[Naxxramas Itemization Changes]

Half of the Attack Power on Bonescythe has been converted to agility at a 85% rate an item with 88 attack power now has 38 Agility and 44 Attack Power.

Bonescythe items that have Strength has had the Strength converted to 85% Attack Power and 15% Agility. If an item had 30 Strength, 30 Agility, it now has 35 Agility and 25 Attack Power.

[Naxxramas Itemization Changes] 

Earthshatter has had all strength on gear converted to 1 Agility and 1 Attack Power. 
Some hit rating has been replaced by critical strike rating on the set.

Additionally, the set bonuses changes made below were to help match earthshatter's identity as an agility hybrid set. 

  - 4 Set: You gain an additional 25% of your Intellect as Melee Attack Power and 8% of your Agility as Hit Rating.
  - 8 Set: Dealing direct damage with a melee ability increases your spell damage by 6% for 6 seconds. Dealing Direct magic damage increases your Agility by 60 for 6 seconds.

[Naxxramas Itemization Changes] - Entry Changelog, there are more changes to come. 

Spirit on Frostfire Items have been shifted into Spell Power, Haste, Hit or Critical Strike Rating.

Additionally, the "Spell Barrage" Triggered from the 2 & 8 set now deals 25% more damage.
[Naxxramas Gear] Restoration Druid Set 8 Set Bonus now only increases Healing done by 6% and haste rating by 100.

[Naxxramas New Gear]

   - Protection Paladin inspired gear.

      - 2 Set: Your damaging spell and melee attacks have a chance to deal high-threat Holy damage to the target.
      - 4 Set: Spell Damage increased by 10% of your Stamina.
      - 6 Set: While over 75% mana your Block Value is increased by 60.
      - 8 Set: Dealing Direct Magic Damage decreases all damage taken by 1%, stacking up to 7 times and lasting for 10 seconds.

[Naxxramas New Gear]

   - Retribution Paladin inspired gear. 

       - 2 Set: Your damaging melee spells have a chance to trigger a Divine Smite on the target, dealing holy damage.
       - 4 Set: Dealing Direct Spell Damage increases your Strength by 10, stacking up to 5 times.
       - 6 Set: Healing Power increased by 3% of your Strength.
       - 8 Set: Your chance to proc divine smite has doubled and the cooldown is halved, it now also deals 100% increased damage.

[Naxxramas New Gear]

   - 2H tank warrior inspired gear. 

      - 2 Set: After parrying an attack, you take 3% less damage for 4 seconds.
      - 4 Set: Expertise increased by 8 and Hit Rating increased by 16.
      - 6 Set: Every 6 seconds in combat, you gain either 120 Attack Power or 75 Parry Rating. Both effects can not occur simultaneously.
      - 8 Set: Dropping to or below 20% health clears your stagger effect and grants you 100 Defense Rating for 8 seconds. This effect can only occur every 60 seconds.

[Naxxramas New Gear] 

    - Balance Druid inspired gear. 

       - 2 Set: Your direct damaging spells have a chance to increase your Spirit and Spell power by 30.
       - 4 Set: You gain 4% of your Spirit as Spell Hit Rating.
       - 6 Set: Taking magical damage has a chance to increase magic damage dealt by 3%.
       - 8 Set: Your spell casts have a chance to inspire you with the Grace of Elune increasing your Spirit by 10% and your Spell Damage by 10% of your spirit.

[Naxxramas New Gear] 

    - Shadow Priest inspired gear.

      - 2 Set: Your Spirit is increased by 30 when your mana is above 75%.
      - 4 Set: You gain 5% of your Spirit as Spell Power.
      - 6 Set: All resistances are increased by 30
                    Armor increased by 550. 
      - 8 Set: Every 6 seconds in combat, you gain 50 Spell Damage and Critical Strike Rating or 50 Spirit and Haste Rating. Both effects can not occur simultaneously.

[Naxxramas New Gear] 

- Elemental Shaman inspired gear.

   - 2 Set: Your direct damaging spells have a chance to trigger an Elemental Blast, hitting up to 3 targets within 8 yards.
   - 4 Set: Increases your Haste Rating by 6% of your intellect.
   - 6 Set: Reduces cost of spells and abilities by 6%. 
   - 8 Set: Spell Criticals increase your critical strike damage by 2% and critical strike chance by 1%, stacking up to 5 times lasting for 4 seconds.

[Naxxramas New Gear] 

 - Feral Druid inspired gear set bonuses.

       - 2 Set: Your Bleeds have a chance to increase your Agility by 50.
       - 4 Set: You gain 3% of your Agility of Expertise Rating.
       - 6 Set: Taking physical damage has a chance to increase your critical strike chance by 3%.
       - 8 Set: Your Bleeds have a chance to cause a savage rip in the target causing them to bleed out over 8 seconds while also increasing all damage you deal to them by 10%.

[Set Bonus Change] Earthshatter 8 Set now works as follows: 

Dealing direct damage with a melee ability increases your spell damage by 6% for 6 seconds. Dealing Direct magic damage increases your Agility by 60 for 6 seconds.

[Set Bonus Changes] Earthshatter 4 Set now works as follows: 

You gain an additional 25% of your Intellect as Melee Attack Power and 8% of your Agility as Hit Rating.

[Set Bonus Changes] Dreadborne 8 Set now works as follows:

Dealing direct melee damage increases your Haste Rating by 8 and Dealing damage with bleed effects increase your Armor Penetration rating by 4. Both effects stack 10 times and last for 6 seconds.

0.description: [Achievement Reworks] Achievements like the Undying and The Immortal is now shifted towards the Ascended Version of the difficulty rather than being disabled because with our difficulty paradigm being shifted, these achievements were only obtainable in the Flex and Flex heroic mode.

[Achievement Reworks] Naxxramas in addition to its "quarter" achievements for killing all bosses in a quarter will have an individual boss kill achievements for, Flex, Flex Heroic, Ascended and Nightmare mode as well as Realm Firsts for each one of these subcategories.

[Achievement Reworks] Naxxramas will feature completely recustomized achievements suited for Ascension. Achievements such as: 

 - The Dedicated Few (Completing Naxxramas with less than 10 players)
 - They all go down together (Killing all Horsemen within 15 seconds of the first death)
 - Shocking (not crossing polarities and taking damage)
 - The Safety Dance (Nobody taking damage from Heigan the Uncleans dance)

Will now function on Flex and Flex Heroic difficulties.
